name: justsend
description: Work records and a verification contract for coding agents: one record per task_key, evidence that has to exist before a task can be called done.

interface.shortDescription: Work records and a verification gate for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Tracks substantive work in JustSend: one record per task_key, progress notes that carry decisions and dead ends, and a verification contract whose criteria must each carry a failing-then-passing artifact before the task can be completed.
